about.p1: InforAntunes is a Portuguese company specialising in business technology. Since 1997, we have supported organisations across different sectors with software solutions, automation, support and hardware.
about.p2: Headquartered in Lourinhã, we combine the proximity of a regional company with the national reach of a reference technology partner — recognised as PME Líder and PME Excelência.
